title: Shared PPO Update Core
subtitle: The one reusable clipped-PPO optimizer; all continual weighting enters via actor coefficients.

sections.text: One update is $\mathrm{ppo\_epochs}$ passes of minibatch SGD over one or more collected rollout STREAMS (one per task, each already GAE-processed). Each stream $i$ adds $c_i \cdot (\mathrm{clipped\ surrogate}_i)$ to the actor loss, a STANDARD $\mathrm{vf\_coef}\cdot(\mathrm{value\ MSE}_i)$ critic loss, and an entropy bonus $-\mathrm{ent\_coef}\cdot\mathcal{H}_i$; the sum is optimized under a single global grad-norm clip. Only the list of actor coefficients $c_i$ differs between the local phase ($[1]$) and the constrained global phase ($[\omega_1,\dots,\omega_{k-1},\,2\mu\,s_k]$).

KEY STABILIZER: the actor coefficients are renormalized by their sum before use. The dual term $2\mu s_k$ is unbounded in $\mu$; without normalization a large $\mu$ makes the actor gradient dominate the shared grad-norm clip and STARVES the shared critic's value gradient, breaking GAE. Division by the sum is a positive rescaling of the ascent direction: it preserves the relative past/current weighting (and the saddle fixed point) and only bounds the step magnitude. For the local phase ($c=[1]$) it is a no-op.

sections.name: $\mathrm{optimize\_batches}(\mathrm{policy},\ \mathrm{opt},\ \mathrm{streams},\ \mathrm{actor\_coeffs})$
inputs: shared-trunk multi-head actor+critic $\mathrm{policy}$; Adam optimizer $\mathrm{opt}$ over its trainable params
$\mathrm{streams}$: list of GAE rollout batches (obs, actions, old log-probs, advantages, returns, task-id), all of equal length $N=n_\mathrm{envs}\cdot n_\mathrm{steps}$
optional KL early-stop flag $\mathrm{kl\_stop}$ (used by the local phase; the global phase runs full epochs)
outputs: diagnostics: mean pg-loss, value-loss, entropy, approx-KL, clip-fraction

body.text: $S \leftarrow \sum_i c_i$;   if $S > 0$: renormalize $c_i \leftarrow c_i / S$ for all $i$
draw a fresh random permutation of $\{1,\dots,N\}$ (shared by all streams)
for each minibatch index set $\mathrm{idx}$ (size $\mathrm{mb}$) do
if $\mathrm{bc}$ set and this is the LAST (current-task) stream:  $L \leftarrow L + \mathrm{bc\_coef}\cdot\mathrm{mean}\ \mathrm{KL}(\pi_L \Vert \mathrm{dist})$
accumulate diagnostics (pg, vloss, entropy, approx-KL $=\mathrm{mean}(\rho-1-\log\rho)$, clip-frac)
if $\mathrm{kl\_stop}$ and $\mathrm{target\_kl}>0$ and epoch-mean approx-KL $> \mathrm{target\_kl}$: break
return averaged {pg-loss, value-loss, entropy, approx-KL, clip-frac}

sections.text: The policy parameters move once per minibatch ($\mathrm{ppo\_epochs}\times\mathrm{num\_minibatches}$ steps per update). Only params with requires-grad move (the whole net normally; only the heads under the head-only probe). The critic and entropy terms are IDENTICAL for every stream (coefficients $\mathrm{vf\_coef}$ and $\mathrm{ent\_coef}$); ONLY the actor term carries the per-stream continual weight $c_i$. The KL early-stop is used by the local phase ($\mathrm{kl\_stop}=$ true); the global consolidation phase passes $\mathrm{kl\_stop}=$ false so the retention update is never throttled.
